headline: This area covers a single planning task: reviewing the existing building blocks of the Cowork Local product and deciding which parts to reuse, improve or build from scratch — the code review could neither confirm nor rule out that this review has been done.
what_is_there: The underlying pieces the review is meant to assess do exist in the product: request routing between language models, connections to external tools and services, and the agent that runs Cowork's workflows.
what_is_unclear: The deliverable here is a written assessment rather than working software, so there is nothing in the code that could show whether the evaluation happened. The task's 'To Do' status was not challenged by anything seen.
suggested_action: Ask the owner whether the assessment write-up exists yet, and if so, store it somewhere linked to the ticket so its completion is visible outside the tracker.
